name: Pure Love!
source:
His parents conveniently having went on a world tour, Reiichi is left alone with his childhood friend Miharu. A sudden confession. A kiss without explanation. Then, a short girl barges in and declares that she’s come to have his kids as promised. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
父母方便地进行了一次世界巡演，礼一独自一人与儿时好友三春在一起。突然的告白。没有解释的吻。然后，一个矮个子女孩闯了进来，宣布她按照承诺来生他的孩子。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
